No platform lock-in. No sudden deactivation. No rent. You deploy, you own, you operate. This guide walks you through accepting [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-explained-digital-creators|bitcoin]] for ebook sales using infrastructure designed for regions where financial exclusion is the norm. By the end, you’ll have a fully operational store, automatic crypto payment verification, and instant product delivery—all without depending on third parties. This is not a tutorial. It’s a deployment blueprint.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Platforms fail because they centralize control. They decide who can sell, what can be sold, and how payments flow. Sovereign commerce stacks invert this. You host your store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, ensuring no single point of failure. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which verifies Bitcoin transactions on-chain without requiring buyer accounts or KYC. File delivery happens through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, both secure and scalable. The stack is modular: each component operates independently but integrates seamlessly. If one part fails, the rest continue functioning. This architecture is pressure-tested in markets like Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are constants. It’s not built for convenience—it’s built for survival. You own the code, the data, and the process. No platform can shut you down.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying, gather these elements: a GitHub or Cloudflare account for hosting, a NOWPayments account for crypto processing, and your digital product files. Choose a domain (optional but recommended for professionalism). Ensure your ebook or course files are compressed and ready for upload. Familiarize yourself with Bitcoin wallets—you’ll need one to receive payments. If using Google Apps Script, enable the necessary APIs in your Google Cloud project. For Cloudflare Workers, set up your account and install the Wrangler CLI. Test your files by manually delivering them to ensure they’re error-free. Finally, draft your product page copy and pricing in USD—NOWPayments will convert Bitcoin to USD at transaction time. This preparation ensures a smooth deployment. No step is optional.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start with payment processing. Create a NOWPayments account and generate API keys. Configure a webhook to fire when a Bitcoin payment confirms on-chain. Set the webhook URL to your backend logic—Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script. In your backend, write a script to verify the payment via NOWPayments’ API, then trigger file delivery. For delivery, upload your ebook or course files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Generate shareable links with expiration dates for security. Integrate these links into your backend script so they’re emailed to the buyer post-payment. Test the pipeline end-to-end: simulate a Bitcoin payment, ensure the webhook fires, and confirm file delivery. Debug any failures before going live. This pipeline is your store’s backbone—make it bulletproof.
Sovereign commerce stacks give you ownership, not rent.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Deploy your store to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Point your domain to the live URL if using one. Share the link with your audience. Monitor your NOWPayments dashboard for incoming transactions. When the first Bitcoin payment confirms, the webhook will trigger your backend script. The script verifies the payment, delivers the file, and sends a confirmation email to the buyer. Log every transaction in a Google Sheet or Supabase database for record-keeping. After the first sale, audit the process: did the file deliver instantly? Was the email sent? Did the payment log correctly? Address any issues immediately. Your first transaction is proof of concept—it validates your infrastructure. Celebrate it, then prepare for the next.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once live, optimize for scale. Add more products by duplicating your backend logic and updating file delivery links. Monitor transaction fees—use BSC, Solana, or TRON networks via NOWPayments to keep fees under $0.10. Automate customer support with email templates for common queries. Implement SPF/DKIM/DMARC for email deliverability if using transactional emails. Back up your database weekly to prevent data loss. If traffic increases, upgrade to paid tiers of Cloudflare or Supabase for higher capacity. Consider purchasing the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for advanced blueprints and templates that accelerate scaling. This infrastructure is designed to grow with you—no limits, no throttling. Scale deliberately, not reactively.

Accepting Bitcoin for ebook sales in Kenya requires sovereign commerce infrastructure. Use GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for Bitcoin processing. Deliver files via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. This stack ensures automatic payment verification, instant delivery, and full data ownership. No platforms, no subscriptions, no restrictions. Deploy once, own forever.
Bitcoin payments verify on-chain—no buyer accounts required.

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Set up hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Create a NOWPayments account and generate API keys. 3. Configure a Bitcoin payment webhook to your backend logic. 4. Write a script to verify payments and trigger file delivery. 5. Upload your ebook files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 6. Generate secure, expiring file links for delivery. 7. Test the entire pipeline end-to-end before going live. 8. Deploy your store and share the live URL. 9. Monitor transactions and audit the process after each sale. 10. Scale by adding products and optimizing for higher traffic.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I accept other cryptocurrencies besides Bitcoin?
Yes, NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Configure your payment page to accept BTC, USDT, ETH, or any other coin. Fees remain 0.5% regardless of currency.
What if a buyer sends the wrong amount of Bitcoin?

NOWPayments automatically verifies the exact amount. If the payment is insufficient, the webhook won’t fire, and no file will be delivered. The buyer must send the correct amount to complete the transaction.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your Bitcoin wallet. Send the refund directly to the buyer’s wallet address. Update your transaction records accordingly.
Is this infrastructure legal in Kenya?
Yes, this stack uses globally available tools and complies with international standards. You own the infrastructure, so you’re responsible for adhering to local regulations.
Can I use this for physical products?
This guide focuses on digital products. For physical goods, you’ll need to integrate shipping logic and partner with local delivery services. The payment pipeline remains the same.
